messages:
alex: Heads-up — CloudPartner asked for a concise packaging contract for our Terraform modules + marketplace artifact mapping. They want a minimal, testable surface so their marketplace team can validate deployments. Meeting next week to align.

maria: Sounds good. Proposal for minimal contract: inputs = {region, subnet_ids, instance_type_family, kms_key_id, accelerator_profile}, outputs = {lb_dns, instance_ids, module_version}. Vars should have sane defaults and clear validation messages.

samir: +1. Also call out multi-arch images and model bundle variants. For TF modules add accelerator_profile enum: ["cpu", "gpu", "gpu_ampere"]. That lets marketplace map SKU -> var.

pete: Implementation note: publish module to registry + include a marketplace_manifest.json that maps marketplace SKUs to module vars (region constraints, supported instance families). CI should run a lightweight smoke matrix (x86/arm, cpu/gpu).

claire: I'll own the partner-facing example. I will create an example repo with a tiny sample.tf, README, and a smoke script: "./smoke.sh" which does apply -> healthcheck -> destroy. I'll also include a quick troubleshooting doc for quota errors.

alex: Acceptance criteria for publishing to marketplace: 1) repo contains README + example, 2) marketplace_manifest.json present, 3) GH Actions runs matrix across arch/accel and passes smoke tests, 4) signed artifacts + SBOM attached. Who owns the checklist?

maria: I'll draft the packaging checklist and a publisher playbook and open a PR in infra/marketplace-tools by Wed.

samir: I'll add a GH Actions matrix for linux/arm64 & linux/amd64 and for accel types. I'll reuse refarch-ci workflow. ci-bot, please spin up a run when I push.

ci-bot: ci-bot: created workflow run https://ci.redwood.ai/runs/98765 :white_check_mark:

pete: Example module usage snippet (I'll add to README):

```hcl
module "redwood_private" {
  source = "github.com/redwood/inference/terraform//modules/redwood_private?ref=v1.0.0"
  region = var.region
  accelerator_profile = "gpu"
  instance_type = "g5.xlarge"
  subnet_ids = var.subnet_ids
  kms_key_id = var.kms_key_id
}
```

claire: Don't forget ops/legal: partner will require signed images/artifacts and an SBOM. Add a LICENSE and a sign-off step in the publisher playbook.

alex: Excellent. Sync cadence: quick alignment Friday 10:00am PT. Agenda: packaging checklist review, CI matrix, marketplace manifest schema, example walkthrough. I'll send calendar invite and include CloudPartner contact.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll have a first draft checklist before the sync.

samir: on it, will add the action matrix and a smoke harness.

pete: Added to my calendar. Will stub the README.
